language_code.description: ISO-639-1 or ISO-639-3 code; detected automatically when omitted.

tag_audio_events.description: Tags events such as laughter and footsteps.

diarization_threshold.description: Only with diarize on and num_speakers unset. Higher values predict fewer speakers.

use_multi_channel.description: Each channel holds one speaker; up to 5 channels, each billed at full duration.

entity_detection.description: all, a type, or a category: pii, phi, pci, other, offensive_language.

entity_redaction.description: Same format as entity_detection and must be a subset of it.

no_verbatim.description: Removes filler words, false starts, and non-speech sounds.

use_speaker_library.description: Matches speakers to the workspace speaker library; requires diarize.

detect_speaker_roles.description: Labels speakers agent and customer; requires diarize; 10% surcharge.

keyterms.description: Up to 1000 terms of at most 50 characters and 5 words; 20% surcharge.

transcript_edit.description: Up to 2000 characters; not with entity options or multi-channel; 30% surcharge.

enable_logging.description: false enables zero retention mode, available to enterprise customers only.
